capabilities: open the previous calendar daily note
open the next calendar daily note
create missing daily notes from the configured template
assign hotkeys to the navigation commands
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Docs cover setup but no usage examples or screenshots.
intentEvidence: The core Daily notes feature focuses on today.
motivation: Moving between days when notes are missing requires manual creation, since the core Daily notes feature only centers on today.
problem: Core Daily notes focuses on today, so jumping to yesterday or tomorrow in a journal with skipped days means manually creating missing notes first.
summary: Navigation plugin that opens the previous or next calendar daily note, creating it from your template if missing.
